pkgmetadata.longdescription: tui-battleship is a single-player, single-file Bash implementation of the classic Battleship pen-and-paper game, played in the terminal against the computer. Ship placement can be automatic or manual, fleet composition and key bindings are configurable, and optional desktop notifications are shown via notify-send. Per-user configuration, game log, and high scores are kept under the XDG config/state directories rather than the read-only package assets.
